subject: Kickoff rally: leadership anchors, owner commitments, and QBR dry-run
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: partners@cloudmarket.com, sara@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff rally: leadership anchors, owner commitments, and QBR dry-run

Team —

We’re kicking off Q2 goal-setting this week. Quick note to align on what I need from leadership by EOD Thursday so we can lock the OKR slate and schedule the QBR dry-run next week. High level: we want a compact slate (3–5 org objectives), owners assigned, and top 3 measurable key results for each objective.

Ask list:
- Confirm owners for objectives in the attached OKR_owners_matrix_2027Q2.csv (column "proposed owner") — reply inline if you need swaps.
- Review the attached kickoff deck (Q2_kickoff_rally_deck_v1.pptx) for the leadership anchors and the proposed measurement rubric.
- Add any hard dependencies (infra, legal, partnerships) — mark them in column D of the matrix.
- RSVP to the QBR dry-run (invite attached) if you can attend: Monday 17 May, 10:00–12:00 PT.

I’ll consolidate responses and publish the final slate Friday morning. If an objective needs a larger discussion, flag it and we’ll spin up a short sync.

Thanks — let’s keep this tight.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Product Operations | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments: Q2_kickoff_rally_deck_v1.pptx (pptx), OKR_owners_matrix_2027Q2.csv (csv), QBR_dryrun_invite.ics (calendar)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff rally: leadership anchors, owner commitments, and QBR dry-run

Sean —
Thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes from my side:
- I can own Objective 2 (Platform: reduce inference tail latency) but want to shift one KR toward sustained 95th percentile rather than p99 — less noisy for customers.
- I added a dependency on the infra team for KV cache tuning in the matrix (row 4).
- I’ll be out Thu afternoon but can confirm owners before EOD.

I reviewed the deck — I think slide 6 (measurement rubric) could use a short example tying a customer-facing metric to cost-per-1000-tokens. I’ll add a slide suggestion and send a tiny update by 2pm.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Serving & Reliability | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Sean + team —
Two quick calls out from Product/Go-to-Market perspective:
1) Measurement: For objectives tied to adoption (search, embeddings, chat), we should agree on denominator definitions (active customers vs. active deployments). I proposed "monthly active inference customers" in column F of the matrix.
2) Cross-org cadence: We have a large customer (Acme Analytics) with a contract milestone in June — their deliverable maps to Objective 1. Can we mark a quick pre-QBR rehearsal with the Account Exec and Solutions Engineer? I included Sara (Acme) on this thread.

Also: if we make hard commitments that affect pricing/discounts, I’ll need a heads up two weeks before finalization.
